grandparents_cupboard.reason: Oats, eggs, milk, honey, butter, almonds, yoghurt and blackberries are all plain kitchen staples with nothing factory-made.

supermarket.reason: Every ingredient, including flaked almonds and blackberries in late August, is an everyday item at any mainstream supermarket.

basic_kitchen.reason: It needs only a bowl, a whisk and a baking dish, and the only technique is mixing and baking.

works.reason: 200g oats to 400ml milk with two eggs, baked at 190°C for 30 to 35 minutes, will set into a good, generous baked oats for four.

honest_times.reason: Ten minutes to whisk, stir and scatter is realistic, and the 35 minute cook matches the bake in the steps.

honest_ingredients.reason: Every listed ingredient and seasoning is used in the steps, and flaked almonds are the same food as the almonds id.

seasonal_feel.reason: Late August is peak blackberry time, and 300g of berries baked through and scattered on top makes them the point of the dish.

plain_voice.reason: The steps are clear, homely British English that a beginner could follow.

hearty_healthy.reason: Oats, eggs, fruit and yoghurt with only 2 tbsp of honey make a filling, wholesome breakfast a family would happily repeat.
